gpu.name: Intel Graphics (Core Ultra 7 155U, Meteor Lake integrated)
equivalents: Intel Iris Xe (Tiger Lake+) or newer Intel integrated graphics

notes: Floors are measured on the named reference GPU via scripts/check-release-soak-{browser,electron}.mjs and verified by scripts/check-min-spec-floors.mjs.
Each soak cycle performs one public save (F5) and one public load (F9) plus an undock/dock/trade round-trip; 200 cycles bound both the cycle count and the two-hour wall duration.
Hitch accounting counts every requestAnimationFrame gap above 50 ms across the whole soak window, normalized per minute.

Player-initiated loading spans (save-write, load-restore, undock, dock-mount, waypoint map toggle, market mount+trade) are transitions: a hitch inside one is a transition cost bounded per event at maxTransitionHitchMs and still fully recorded. The <=1/minute floor applies to gameplay hitches (steady flight, docked idle UI); both counts are reported.

The game's own hitch classifier (PQ-129.02) attributes each gap to an owner. A hitch it attributes to externalScheduling is a gap the page did not consume — shared-machine noise, not product work. Those events are recorded per-event, reported as externalSchedulingHitchCount, and excluded from the gameplay floor; hitches attributed to game work, or left unknown/ambiguous, always count against it.
Boot anchors at page navigation -> menu for the browser host and process launch -> menu for Electron; the harness-inclusive launch->menu figure is recorded alongside for attribution.
